I have a Sunsun filter on my 60g, specifically, the HW-403B (with UV and surface skimmer), and it works just as good as the Rena/API filter that used to filter the same tank. It's definitely really good for the value, but I've heard from a few people that have gotten Sunsun's with bad luck, so it's hit and miss. Mine has been going for... about 4-5 months now? With absolutely no problems.

All I have in mine is literally half sponges (four total, two three the filter came with and two Marineland sponges), and the other half ceramic rings (including the rings that the filter came with, added another 500g box of rings) and the Bio-balls that came with it as well. Along with a small bag of Phosphate media, it's pretty full and it's working very well :)
